Package persist.lint.api.spi

Interface SchemaValidator

All Superinterfaces:
PersistenceLinter
All Known Implementing Classes:
JakartaSchemaValidator, LegacySchemaValidator
public interface SchemaValidator extends PersistenceLinter
Service provider interface for validating a JPA persistence schema against a live database at build time.

Implementations use the entity metamodel built from the discovered annotated classes and compare it with the actual database schema reachable through the supplied connection properties.

Since:
2.1.0

  • Method Details

    • validateSchema

      void validateSchema(Map<String,String> connectionProperties)
      Validates the persistence schema against the database described by the given connection properties.

      The map is expected to contain at least the keys "driver", "url", "username", and "password".

      Parameters:
      connectionProperties - JDBC connection properties used to reach the target database
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the schema does not match the entity metamodel
